title: Reproducible and wrong: silent failures in archaeological visibility analysis and a benchmark to catch them — code, benchmark and landscape laboratory
description: Defect-injectable line-of-sight engine, an executable benchmark (terrain cases with derived expectations plus behavioural properties) audited by mutation analysis, and a synthetic-landscape laboratory with ground truth by construction that measures what design-level defects (unmasked water, tightly cropped null-sampling regions) do to statistical inference. Includes every result file, the figure and manuscript generators, and the audit. NumPy-only. Companion deposit to the manuscript of the same title.

creators.name: Mamani Calisaya, Milton Vladimir
